outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot; no averaged data is presented.
Panel B contains micrograph/fluorescence/bright-field images, not a plot showing averages.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC).
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid for both High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic/model illustration summarizing the immunosuppressive niche, not a data plot.
